name: Protein Overnight Oats (Greek yogurt + whey)
steps: Whisk yogurt, milk and whey until smooth
Stir in oats, sweetener, vanilla and salt
Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours
Loosen with a splash of milk, top with fruit

name: Paneer Bhurji
steps: Fry cumin, onion and chilli till golden
Add ginger garlic paste, cook off raw smell
Add tomato, salt, turmeric; cook till mushy
Stir in chilli powder and garam masala
Add capsicum/peas and paneer, toss 2 min
Finish with coriander and lemon

name: Egg Bhurji (Anda Bhurji)
steps: Beat eggs with salt and turmeric
Splutter cumin in hot oil
Saute onion and chilli till golden, add ginger garlic
Cook tomato till soft
Pour in eggs, scramble, add masala and chilli
Take off heat when just set; garnish

name: Masala Omelette
steps: Mix chopped veg with salt and turmeric
Beat eggs till frothy and add veg
Heat oil on medium (not smoking)
Pour in eggs, cook till base sets
Flip and cook through; add pepper or chilli

name: Moong Dal Chilla
steps: Rinse dal, soak 15-20 min
Grind with cumin, ginger, chilli, turmeric and water
Mix in veg, coriander and salt
Spread a ladle thin on a hot tawa
Drizzle oil, flip when edges lift
Serve with green chutney or curd

name: Besan Chilla
steps: Mix besan, ajwain, turmeric and salt
Add veg and water to a pourable batter
Grease a hot pan, lower to medium
Spread a ladle thin, oil the edges
Flip when edges lift; cook till golden
Serve with chutney or curd

name: Paneer Stuffed Besan Chilla
steps: Blend batter ingredients smooth, rest 10 min
Mix paneer and veg for the stuffing
Spread a thin chilla on a hot pan
Add 1 tsp oil, cover and cook on low
Spread stuffing, warm briefly
Roll tight; serve with green chutney

name: Paneer Paratha
steps: Knead a soft dough, rest 20-30 min
Mix paneer with herbs and spices; divide in 8
Stuff each dough ball and seal
Roll gently to 4-5 inch discs
Cook on hot tawa with ghee till golden spots
Serve with curd, chutney or pickle

name: Oats Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
steps: Add everything to a blender
Blend till smooth
Thin with milk if too thick
Serve straight away

name: Soya Chunks Salad with Greek Yogurt Dressing
steps: Soak chunks in hot salted water 15 min, squeeze dry
Pan-fry with spices 2-3 min till crisp
Blend curd, paneer, coriander, garlic, lemon for dressing
Combine veg, soya and seeds
Toss with dressing just before serving

name: Crispy Soya Granules Salad with Paneer Dressing
steps: Blend paneer, cashews, garlic, chillies, lemon, masala with water
Soak granules 5 min, squeeze dry
Fry cumin and curry leaves, add granules and spices
Fry 8-10 min till crisp
Toss veg with half the granules and dressing
Top with remaining granules

name: High-Protein Kala Chana Salad
steps: Dice cucumber, tomato and peppers
Combine veg, kala chana and sprouts
Add paneer or tofu cubes
Pour over dressing, season and toss
Serve now or chill

name: Roasted Paneer Salad
steps: Coat paneer in yogurt and spices
Roast at 200 C for 18-20 min (or tawa)
Mix chopped veg and herbs
Season veg with lemon, salt, pepper
Fold in slightly cooled paneer and serve

name: Rajma (Kidney Bean) Salad
steps: Soak rajma overnight, pressure cook till soft, cool
Chop onion, tomato, chilli, coriander
Mix rajma with veg
Dress with lemon, oil and salt
Top with roasted peanuts

name: Boiled Egg Salad (hung curd)
steps: Boil eggs 10-12 min, rest, cool in cold water
Peel and chop into bite-size pieces
Add hung curd and remaining ingredients
Mix gently, adjust salt
Serve on toast or in a wrap

name: Chana Chaat (Chickpea Salad)
steps: Soak chana 6-8 hours
Pressure cook 3-4 whistles, drain and cool
Mix in salt, chaat masala, cumin, lemon
Add onion, tomato, cucumber, chilli, coriander
Add curd on top for extra protein (optional)

name: Paneer aur Hare Chane ka Salad
steps: Soak and boil hara chana till just tender
Cube paneer and tomato, chop spring onion
Combine chana, paneer and veg
Season with lemon, black salt, cumin, pepper
Toss and serve

name: Rajma Masala
steps: Soak rajma 8-12 hours, rinse
Pressure cook 4-5 whistles till soft
Fry cumin, bay leaf, onion, chilli; add ginger garlic
Cook tomato puree till raw smell goes
Add spices, then rajma with stock; simmer 10-15 min
Finish with garam masala and kasuri methi

name: Chana Paneer Masala
steps: Soak chana overnight, pressure cook 3 whistles
Fry cumin and ginger garlic paste
Saute onion till golden
Cook tomato 4-5 min, add spices and salt
Add chana with water, simmer 8-10 min
Add paneer and kasuri methi, cook 1 min

name: Soya Chunks Curry
steps: Soak chunks in boiling water, squeeze and rinse
Blend tomato and coconut to a paste
Fry cumin, curry leaves, onion, chilli till golden
Add ginger garlic, then tomato paste; cook thick
Add spices and soya, saute 3 min
Add hot water, simmer 5-8 min

name: Palak Paneer
steps: Saute chillies, cashews, spinach till wilted; cool
Blend to a smooth puree
Fry onion till golden, add ginger garlic
Cook tomato and salt, add garam masala
Add water and kasuri methi, then spinach puree
Stir in paneer, simmer briefly

name: Paneer Jalfrezi
steps: Puree tomatoes, cut paneer into strips
Fry cumin and chilli, cook sliced onion 5 min
Add ginger garlic, spices and tomato; cook thick
Stir-fry peppers and diced onion 4-5 min
Add paneer and kasuri methi, cover 2-3 min
Serve with roti or rice

name: Dal Fry
steps: Pressure cook dal 2-3 whistles, mash
Temper cumin, mustard, hing in hot oil
Fry onion and chilli, add ginger garlic
Cook tomato with salt till soft
Add spices and dal, simmer with water
Finish with kasuri methi, coriander, lemon

name: Dhaba Style Egg Curry
steps: Prick boiled eggs, fry in 1 tsp oil till golden
Fry whole spices, then onion and chilli
Add ginger garlic, then tomato till mushy
Add powders and salt, saute
Add water, simmer till thick
Add eggs and kasuri methi; cream optional

name: Soya Chunks Pulao
steps: Boil soya in salted water 5 min, drain
Fry cumin and whole spices in ghee
Add onion, ginger garlic, chilli; cook
Add spices and tomato till mushy
Add veg and soya, then water, salt; boil
Add rice and herbs, cover and cook 20 min

name: Chana Saag (Chana Palak)
steps: Soak chana overnight, pressure cook 3-4 whistles
Saute ginger, garlic, chilli and onion till golden
Wilt spinach 2-3 min, cool and blend with coriander
Cook tomato and salt, add garam masala, chana, water
Simmer 5 min, stir in saag paste
Bubble 1-2 min and serve

name: Mango Protein Lassi
steps: Add everything to a blender
Blend till smooth
Top with a pinch of cinnamon and mint

name: Peanut Butter Whey Smoothie
steps: Soak almonds overnight and peel
Soak oats in water 4 hours
Blend everything till smooth
Serve chilled

name: Chilli Soya Chunks
steps: Soak chunks in hot salted water 5 min, squeeze
Coat with corn flour and spices
Fry (or air-fry / pan-sear) till crisp
Saute ginger garlic, onion, capsicum, chillies
Add sauces, vinegar and salt
Toss in soya and spring onion

name: Paneer Tikka
steps: Mix curd, spices, ginger garlic and oil
Coat veg, then paneer
Rest in fridge 1-2 hours, skewer
Air-fry 200 C 5+2 min, or tawa, or oven 230 C
Brush with marinade and finish

name: Soya Chunks Cutlet (Soya Tikki)
steps: Soak soya in hot salted water 10 min, squeeze
Pulse coarsely in a mixer
Mix in spices, onion, paste, spring onion, besan
Shape into small tikkis with oiled hands
Shallow fry on low till golden both sides
Serve with curd and green chutney

name: Khaman Dhokla
steps: Whisk water, citric acid, sugar, salt, oil, ginger, chilli, semolina
Sieve in besan and turmeric; whisk, rest 10 min
Add Eno, mix till frothy, pour into greased pan
Steam 18-20 min; cool
Temper mustard, curry leaves, chillies; add sugar water
Pour over sliced dhokla

name: Paneer Sandwich
steps: Mix paneer, veg, chilli, coriander and salt
Add sauce and chaat masala or lemon
Butter bread outsides, spread chutney inside
Fill and close
Toast till golden

name: Peanut Chaat
steps: Chop the veg
Combine everything in a bowl
Toss and serve straight away

name: Dry Chana Masala
steps: Soak chana 8 hours, pressure cook
Splutter mustard, cumin, chilli, curry leaves, hing
Add ginger garlic, then chana
Stir in spices and salt, saute 1 min
Squeeze lemon and serve

name: Soya Chunks Dry Fry
steps: Boil soya 5 min, rinse, squeeze dry
Fry cumin, curry leaves, hing, chilli, onion
Add ginger garlic, cook off raw smell
Cook tomato, salt, turmeric till mushy
Add chilli powder, garam masala and soya; cover 3-5 min
Saute 2-3 min, garnish coriander

name: Palak Tofu
steps: Marinate tofu in lemon, salt, chilli, garam masala
Saute onion, ginger, garlic, chilli; add tomato
Wilt spinach 4-5 min, cool
Blend with cashews to a smooth puree
Simmer puree with spices and kasuri methi
Pan-fry tofu golden, add to gravy with lemon

name: Tofu Kadai
steps: Press tofu and cube it
Fry curry leaves, ginger, spices, tomato till thick
Pan-fry tofu golden; set aside
Saute onion and peppers 3 min
Add tofu, soy sauce, salt, kasuri methi; simmer 3 min
Serve with roti or rice

name: Tofu Bhurji
steps: Drain and crumble tofu by hand
Saute curry leaves, onion, chilli ~6 min
Add ginger garlic, then tomato, salt, turmeric
Add tofu, saute 6 min
Add spices and kasuri methi, 1-2 min
Garnish; serve with roti or toast

name: Moong Dal Khichdi
steps: Rinse rice and dal; soak 30 min if no cooker
Temper bay leaf, cumin, ginger, hing in ghee
Saute onion, chilli, tomato, veg, turmeric, salt
Add rice and dal, saute, add water
Pressure cook 2-5 whistles
Top with ghee; serve with curd

name: Egg Keema
steps: Boil, cool and finely chop eggs
Fry whole spices and cumin
Cook onion golden, add ginger garlic and tomato
Add spices, then peas
Add a little water, salt and herbs; thicken
Fold in the chopped eggs

name: Soya Keema (Soya Granules)
steps: Soak granules in hot water, rinse, squeeze dry
Temper whole spices in oil
Saute onion, add ginger garlic
Cook tomato, turmeric, chilli till mushy
Add soya, peas, cauliflower, pepper and a little water
Add kasuri methi, garam masala, cashew paste; simmer

name: Moong Dal Tadka
steps: Rinse and soak dal
Fry cumin, ginger, chilli, curry leaves, onion
Add tomato, salt and spices
Add dal and water; pressure cook 4-5 whistles
Mash, add kasuri methi and amchur
Pour garlic-chilli tadka over
